summary: mangomind-agent establishes remote-controlled shell execution channel via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: src/index.js opens a persistent WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app and handles inbound 'diagnosis' messages by passing msg.fixCommand directly to child_process.execSync when msg.autoFix is set, giving any party in control of (or able to impersonate on) the relay arbitrary shell execution on the installer's host with the running user's privileges. A second channel handles 'opencode_request' messages by relaying arbitrary HTTP method/path/body from the WebSocket to a locally spawned 'opencode serve' instance bound to 127.0.0.1, which exposes the local OpenCode agent's code- and tool-execution surface to the same remote relay. A --install-service flag writes a Windows Scheduled Task (onlogon, highest privileges), a macOS LaunchAgent plist with RunAtLoad+KeepAlive, or a Linux systemd --user unit with Restart=always, embedding the relay token and re-launching the agent on every boot so the remote-execution channel persists across reboots. os.hostname() and platform information are additionally reported to the relay.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
